name: surveilToActions
signature: export function surveilToActions(effect: Extract<ExtendedEffect, { do: 'surveil' }>, ctx: AbilityContext, env: PrimitiveEnv): PrimitiveResult
rules: CR 701.44a look at the top N, put any number into the graveyard, rest on top in any order
contract: Same decision shape as scry, different destination: graveyard rather than bottom of library. The two must not share an implementation that parameterises the destination, because their deferred text differs and a player reading the log must see which one happened.
An empty library emits nothing and defers nothing.
Surveil 1 defers: graveyard or top is a real choice.
It emits no MOVE_ZONE to the graveyard speculatively. Milling a card the player would have kept is not a recoverable mistake.

evidence.claim: surveil is a player decision delegated to the player object

assertions.expect: zero actions, one deferred that says surveil and not scry

assertions.given: surveil 2 with one card in the library
assertions.expect: the deferred line names one card, not two
